An animated short gives Joe Rogan's DMT tale the JRE Toon treatment. The file is not a full talk but a cartoon cut of a famed bit from the show. Rogan's voice tells the trip tale while the art plays it out.

Rogan tells of the blast, the elves, and the jester-like beings of his most told trip. The toon form makes the wild tale light and quick. Fans of the show know the bit by heart and quote it often. Listeners get a fun, short gem from the show's vault. The library holds the file as an archive record of the short.
